Clinical audit of new thrombosis incidence over a 3-month period in sarcoma clinic patients undergoing chemotherapy, to assess need for primary thromboprophylaxis.

Treatment pathway review for GIST patients on TKIs (imatinib, sunitinib, regorafenib, ripretinib, avapritinib), focused on neoadjuvant imatinib response and time to surgical resection, split by localised vs metastatic disease.
Review of treatment regimens used for metastatic soft tissue sarcoma patients who received at least one line of systemic therapy, with histological subtype breakdown.

Review of neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemotherapy use in patients over 40 with localised bone sarcoma (osteosarcoma, Ewing, chondrosarcoma, giant cell tumour, undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma), given scarce evidence in older adults.
Business case for a cancer assessment unit (CAU) counting cancer patients presenting to A&E with suspected or actual malignant spinal cord compression, and whether they are admitted or discharged.
Osteosarcoma feasibility audit of first-line 3-drug versus 2-drug (AP) chemotherapy and second-line regimens over the last 3 years, broken down by age, sex and ethnicity.
Review of whether switching to a new filgrastim brand (Accofil) for stem cell mobilisation increased the need for plerixafor rescue, using pharmacy dispensing records.

Audit of biopsy mode (FNA, core needle, excisional) and its effect on diagnostic accuracy and time-to-diagnosis in Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients diagnosed 2020-2024, including re-biopsy decisions and treatment-line outcomes.
Re-audit of tolerability of the cyclophosphamide (Cyclo-prime) mobilisation protocol after removal of a spare mesna dose.

12-month trial of prophylactic nasogastric tube placement in TYA and myeloablative-conditioning allogeneic stem cell transplant patients, assessing nutrition status, GI symptoms, and engraftment/GvHD outcomes.
Audit of management and outcomes for low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma against current guidelines, distinguishing low- from high-grade serous histology.
Review of the indolent systemic mastocytosis (ISM) cohort and uptake of the mastocytosis symptom assessment (MAS) score form, including tryptase levels.

Tolerability and outcomes of radiotherapy to the primary and bone metastases in metastatic prostate cancer patients treated 2015-2025, including Gleason grade, metastatic burden, and androgen deprivation therapy timing.
Assessment of ethnicity and first-language recording completeness for cancer patients, to inform interventions improving equitable access to cancer clinical trials.
Outcomes of cancer-associated VTE patients whose anticoagulation was dose-reduced after six months, tracking recurrent VTE; companion to Requests 27 and 44.
Use of RNA sequencing for MRD marker identification in ALL patients since 2021, linking HILIS lab data with Epic clinical outcomes including induction response and progression to transplant/CAR-T.
Outcomes of cancer patients with tumour thrombus, identified via free-text 'tumour thrombus' search within a defined clinic cohort; companion to Requests 27 and 42.
Response and tolerability of ITP patients treated with eltrombopag and avatrombopag, including adverse events (even if unrelated to the drug) and routine bloods.

Assessment of patient uptake of the MPN10-SAF symptom assessment questionnaire sent to MPN clinic patients since Nov 2022, and correlation of SAF scores with symptoms reported at the corresponding clinic visit.
Feasibility of building a non-small-cell lung cancer dataset from histopathology reports for patients treated with immunotherapy (nivolumab, pembrolizumab, etc.) since 2020.

For 270 early breast cancer patients with Oncotype DX genomic testing, collection of chemotherapy/endocrine/OFS/bisphosphonate treatment, node status, TNM staging, tumour grade/histology, and ER/PR/Ki-67 results.
Investigation pathway for eosinophilia/hypereosinophilia patients since 2019, including which clinics reviewed them, bone marrow biopsy, and strongyloides testing.
Summary of recent use of the HAEMWRGENERIC smartphrase by inpatient clinicians, and whether the problem list is populated in the new haematology ward-round proforma introduced Feb 2025.
Prospective CAR-T registry for lymphoma (DLBCL) patients tracking disease characteristics, treatment/survival dates, medications, ITU admission, and CRS/ICANS grading after leukapheresis.
Cohort identification of mantle cell lymphoma patients with a SACT plan for a multi-centre audit of BTKi-treated patients who developed CNS involvement; CNS status descoped to manual chart review.
Cohort of autologous stem cell transplant patients from the past 2 years to evaluate impact of conditioning regimens on nutritional status and benefit of prophylactic nasogastric tube feeding.
Correlation between sub-therapeutic posaconazole levels and treatment failure in AML patients on reduced-dose venetoclax/azacitidine since May 2025.

Steroid-prescribing habits, dosing/tapering, and adverse effects (metabolic, infective, neurological) in primary CNS lymphoma patients from presentation through end of cycle 1 chemotherapy, assessed against NICE monitoring guidelines.
Audit of compliance with national operation-note standards and postoperative antibiotic use for laparoscopic appendicectomy patients (non-cancer).
Assessment of acute diverticulitis management (bloods, CT imaging, antibiotics/IV fluids, follow-up colonoscopy) against national guidelines (non-cancer).
Treatment response, PFS and OS outcomes in bile duct cancer/cholangiocarcinoma patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors, with or without additional systemic agents, Jan 2020-March 2025.
National HaemSTAR ATOMM audit of thromboprophylaxis strategies, VTE and bleeding rates in newly diagnosed myeloma patients starting first-line systemic therapy 2021-2024.
Multi-cohort study of MPN/MDS overlap patient characteristics, transfusion dependence, splenomegaly on imaging, treatment lines, blood counts, NGS molecular results, and bone marrow fibrosis grade.
Identification of sickle cell disease patients with fentanyl PCA on their care plan during admission for a sickle cell crisis.

Retrospective analysis of diagnostic pathway timelines for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patients at UCLH and the Royal Free, comparing high-risk surveillance cohorts against registry controls, with staging, resection and survival outcomes.
Annual count of cases discussed across six cancer MDTs (lung, breast, prostate, lymphoma, bowel, melanoma) over the last 5 years, to support a grant application for MDT software development.

Cohort of lymphoma patients admitted to ICU at UCLH, to calculate ICU and in-hospital mortality by care level and explore prognosis and prior treatment (SACT vs CAR-T vs treatment-naive) as predictors.
List of epithelioid hemangioendothelioma patients treated with sirolimus and other chemotherapies over 10 years, with dosing and response, to support an internal funding application.
Baseline usage of iron infusion and red blood cell transfusion in oncology patients with Hb<12 or Hb<8, broken down by treatment modality and specialty, to support a trust anaemia/iron-stock audit.
Sarcoma patients on active SACT and the subset started on high-dose anticoagulation, to evaluate evidence for routine primary VTE thromboprophylaxis given observed VTE incidence.

Detailed cohort of oesophageal cancer patients treated with radical-intent radiotherapy, covering staging, fitness, treatment delivery and disease progression, to identify prognostic indicators of tolerance and outcomes.

Re-audit of autologous stem cell transplant outcomes in lymphoma patients since 2019, comparing non-relapse vs treatment-related mortality and transplant volumes by indication against a 2019 baseline audit.

Compliance with the updated post-CAR-T PCP prophylaxis guideline (co-trimoxazole vs alternatives) and blood count monitoring through 12 months, to check safety of relaxed count thresholds for starting prophylaxis.
Clinical response and overall survival of patients with transformed low-grade lymphoma (follicular or marginal zone) progressing to high-grade lymphoma (DLBCL/HBL).
Counts of endometrial cancer patients treated at UCLH in 2024, including how many received immunotherapy (pembrolizumab/dostarlimab) or chemotherapy.

Annual counts of patients (2019-2024) actively treated for ovarian, endometrial, cervical, vulval and vaginal cancers with chemotherapy, immunotherapy or PARP inhibitors, to build a business case for additional gynae-oncology CNS staff.

Cohort of patients undergoing radical prostatectomy as first treatment for localised prostate cancer, tracking post-op PSA, subsequent PSMA PET/MRI imaging and radiotherapy, to characterise patterns of biochemical/imaging recurrence.

Service evaluation of GI oncology inpatients and outpatients since 2020, by diagnosis, patient/GP postcode, length of stay, clinic attendance and completed SACT cycles, to assess the volume of out-of-area patients.
Review of follow-up and management of MPN clinic patients with MPL mutations over 5 years, including free-text searches for MPL, JAK2 and 'triple negative' status.

Retrospective review of lung cancer patients on tyrosine kinase inhibitors (e.g. osimertinib, alectinib) over 12 months, assessing cardiovascular monitoring compliance and rates of TKI-related cardiac complications.

Overall and progression-free survival in adult acute lymphoblastic leukaemia patients, including demographics, Beacon treatment data and blinatumomab/inotuzumab dosing, compared against published outcomes.
Audit of treatments received, clinical history and symptom assessment in systemic mastocytosis patients, including free-text search for KIT and tryptase mentions across diagnosis synonym variants.

Molecular profiling study (INDAGA-UK) of locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic salivary gland cancer patients diagnosed 2013-2024 with archival tissue, covering demographics, smoking/alcohol status and pathology sample availability.
Lung cancer patients undergoing curative-intent radiotherapy, checking whether they received a PET-CT within 6 weeks before treatment and referral timing between lung clinical and medical oncology.

Number of patients prescribed lenvatinib across tumour subtypes (predominantly gynae and thyroid cancers), to assess feasibility of a dedicated cardiology clinic for lenvatinib-related hypertension and cardiac failure.
Frequency of out-of-hours aseptically prepared SACT manufacture (drug, time, date) across all ages and in/outpatients, to justify continued investment in the out-of-hours pharmacy service.

Radiotherapy dose to mediastinal organs at risk in lymphoma patients receiving mediastinal RT, comparing proton vs photon therapy and cardiac risk factors such as diabetes, cholesterol, smoking and BMI.

Identification of gastrointestinal oncology patients with genetic profiling results (Foundation Medicine, Caris, Guardant360 PDFs) since 2019, to correlate genomic data with systemic treatment response and survival across GI cancer subtypes.
Study of radiation-induced alopecia in brain tumour patients treated with proton beam therapy, correlating scalp dose received with alopecia grade at baseline, on-treatment and follow-up.

Feasibility study of real-world treatment patterns and outcomes in newly diagnosed locally advanced (stage III-IVb) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma since 2018, using ICD-10/ICD-O-3 codes, stage and smoking/alcohol history.

Audit of tyrosine kinase inhibitor prescribing practices (e.g. imatinib, dasatinib, ponatinib) after allogeneic transplant or CAR-T therapy, including Ph+/BCR::ABL1 status and explicit capture of patients who did not receive a TKI.
Counts of prostate cancer patients with both prostate MRI and PSMA PET imaging within 120 days, to support feasibility of a tumour-delineation AI project.
Outcomes (remission, relapse, allograft, death) of adult T-ALL/T-LBL patients since 2019, noting that T-LBL cases are not reliably captured in HILIS and must be retrieved from Epic instead.

Patients with atypical endometrial hyperplasia (2015-2025), tracking hysteroscopic biopsy frequency, progesterone treatment duration, hysterectomy rates, and subsequent diagnosis of endometrial cancer.

Patients with lymphoma-associated haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) since EPIC inception, plus lymphoma patients admitted to ICU who may meet undiagnosed HLH criteria, given HLH's poor survival.

Retrospective 2010-2024 cohort study of oesophagogastric adenocarcinoma and colorectal cancer comparing trends in diagnostic age, stage, treatment pathways, and survival between young-onset (<50) and late-onset (>=60) patients.
Count of haematology inpatients/outpatients with a recorded penicillin allergy, to identify patients eligible for referral to the penicillin allergy delabelling service.

Audit of antifungal (echinocandin/fluconazole) prescribing for candidaemia in oncology inpatients (2022-2025) against guideline compliance on agent choice, dosing, de-escalation, source control, and susceptibility-testing follow-up.
Cohort identification of patients diagnosed with head & neck rhabdomyosarcoma (parameningeal and non-parameningeal) to review imaging features at presentation and correlate with outcome.
Identification of MPN patients on hydroxycarbamide who developed skin cancer since 2020, to establish high-risk groups and introduce risk-reduction measures.
Audit of patients with a G6PD deficiency diagnosis to assess whether existing clinical advice has led to any haemolysis cases, contacting the cohort via questionnaire for publication.
Cohort of BRCA-associated versus BRCA wild-type high-grade serous ovarian cancer/STIC patients, comparing stage at diagnosis, presentation, surgical complexity and outcomes.

Review of documentation of patients' religion/faith on admission for oncology and haematology inpatients over 6 months, including whether the record was later updated, to inform spiritual care provision.

Usage split of lomustine (including 10mg capsules) across haematology, oncology and TYA/paediatrics by protocol and cycle number for the last financial year, following discontinuation of the licensed capsule.

Longitudinal inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, blood counts) and steroid dosing over 4 weeks post-CAR-T infusion for ~267 patients (2019-2022), to identify risk factors for prolonged ICANS/encephalopathy.

Count of female patients with RAD51C/RAD51D/BRIP1/PALB2 mentioned in gynaecological clinic free text (2019-2025), to estimate numbers eligible for ROCA ovarian cancer surveillance testing under NICE guidance.

Evaluation of the 'Buddy Project' addressing inequalities in prostate cancer care for Black men, comparing referral, treatment and loss-to-follow-up rates by ethnicity before and after the initiative.

Cohort of children/adolescents (0-17) treated for osteosarcoma 2014-2024, including those on the EURAMOS protocol, to study nutritional support (gastrostomy vs nasogastric feeding) and growth/health outcomes.

Cholangiocarcinoma patients admitted since 2020 with blood-culture-proven biliary bacteraemia, linking organism trends, survival, ICU admission and biliary interventional radiology/ERCP procedures to admission cost and outcomes.
Continuation extract of colorectal cancer patients (ICD C18-20) diagnosed since 2019 with Epic and SACT data, to complete a previously shared spreadsheet.

Cohort of early-stage (I-II) high-grade serous or clear-cell ovarian cancer patients undergoing staging surgery with lymphadenectomy (2019-2024), to assess nodal metastasis incidence, risk factors, and safety of omitting systematic lymphadenectomy.
Cohort of olfactory neuroblastoma patients treated with photon or proton radiotherapy since 2010, comparing oncological outcomes and long-term treatment-related effects.
Count of MPN patients (polycythaemia vera, myelofibrosis, essential thrombocythaemia) treated in the past 24 months, for a sponsor questionnaire.
Mandatory NHS England audit of plerixafor use for stem cell mobilisation (April 2023-March 2024), covering dose counts, CD34+ cell yield, collection days, and engraftment timing.

Retrospective review of sickle cell patients with Acute Chest Syndrome who could not be transfused (due to hyperhaemolysis/antibodies) and were managed with pre-emptive HFNO or CPAP, assessing benefit versus invasive ventilation and length of stay.
Review of ~100 oncology ward patients to assess how special blood transfusion requirements are documented, aiming to improve documentation practice and transfusion safety.
Audit of adherence to trust guidelines (from July 2024) on diagnosing and managing diabetes in haematology and oncology patients starting SACT, using diabetes diagnosis, HbA1c and glucose results.
Retrospective real-world review of prostate cancer patients treated with radium-223 for symptomatic bone metastases, evaluating outcomes and toxicity against the ALSYMPCA trial.

Detailed timeline extraction for sarcoma patients accessing free-of-charge drug schemes, covering application, approval, dosing changes, toxicity and treatment outcomes, to evaluate scheme processes and timelines.
Service evaluation of dietetic input during radiotherapy over 6 months, identifying most commonly seen tumour groups, referral timing, weight loss, and nutritional risk at first contact.

Urine output, volume and pH time-series for sarcoma and lymphoma patients receiving high-dose methotrexate (Sept 2024-Sept 2025), to assess guideline adherence and reduce toxicity/avoidable glucarpidase use.
Quantification of patient deferrals and clinic capacity in breast oncology outpatient clinics over three months, including repeated-deferral patterns, to inform workforce planning.
Ethnicity and preferred-language data for all cancer service patients attending in 2025, replicating a prior year's extract as baseline for a quality improvement project on equity documentation.
Identification of non-metastatic lung cancer patients with a normal brain PET signal, to build a control dataset for a quantitative PET analysis tool supporting epilepsy surgery biomarker research.

Audit of CTPA requests for suspected pulmonary embolism in adult oncology inpatients, assessing adherence to pre-imaging work-up (ECG, chest X-ray, D-dimer) and diagnostic yield against RCR standards.

Percentage of adult haematology inpatients (leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, BMT etc.) who developed a VTE during admission without a completed VTE risk assessment, or despite prophylactic enoxaparin, for teaching purposes.

Use of the PedsQL Multidimensional Fatigue Scale flowsheet to support fatigue management in paediatric patients (0-18) undergoing proton beam therapy, comparing initial and follow-up occupational/physio therapy scores.

Longitudinal CA125 measurements and chemotherapy regimen details (drug, dates, cycles) in relapsed high-grade serous ovarian cancer patients on at least second-line therapy, to model evolution of carboplatin drug resistance.

Feasibility study on cholangiocarcinoma/biliary tract cancer patients (2020-2025) comparing age-at-diagnosis trends and characterizing under-40 patients by molecular testing, actionable alterations, targeted therapy, and survival.

Identification of all female patients with immature teratoma (all grades) to review surgical and oncological management, including de-escalated chemotherapy/surgery, against national guidance and recurrence/death outcomes.
MRN and SACT regimen counts for patients currently receiving systemic anti-cancer therapy in gynae oncology clinics, to quantify workload growth from increased endometrial cancer treatment volume.

Rate, type, and approach of radical hysterectomy performed for early cervical cancer at UCLH over the last 5 years, including peri-operative complications from operation notes and discharge summaries.
Audit of planned and unplanned Day Care reviews (chemo day care, supportive care, apheresis) documented by a named advanced nurse practitioner, to evaluate the new ANP-led day care service model.

Audit of the proportion of stage IIIB-IV NSCLC patients receiving SACT in Q3 2025, identified via metastatic-related phrases within lung cancer MDM outcome notes, to check for a data-capture gap versus a national target.

Myeloma patients on teclistamab, elranatamab, or talquetamab who paused and resumed treatment with re-priming step-up doses, tracking CRS/ICANS rates and treatment response, to assess feasibility of outpatient re-priming.
Serum calcium and vitamin D levels for haematology inpatients with low blood calcium (Feb-March 2025), to check whether vitamin D deficiency is being investigated as a cause of hypocalcaemia.
Haematology patients with acute kidney injury (Feb-March 2026, presenting or ward-onset) to check whether urine dip testing was part of the initial investigation plan on the day AKI was documented.

Head and neck radiotherapy patients over the last 5 years, tracking subsequent carotid complications (mainly stroke) at any point post-treatment, to assess late radiotherapy effects and inform screening need.

Review of platelet transfusions given to TYA patients (age 13-24) between 2023-2025, capturing pre/post counts, transfusion indication, bleeding status, and tranexamic acid use to assess transfusion effectiveness.

Mandatory NHS England audit of Plerixafor use for stem cell mobilisation, covering dose counts, CD34+ cell yield, collection days, and neutrophil/platelet engraftment time, across two consecutive financial years.

Screening of general haematology clinic patients with raised serum ferritin (sex-specific thresholds) to categorise diagnoses (haemochromatosis, fatty liver, malignancy, undiagnosed) and identify SF3B1 mutation carriers as a possible cause.

Service evaluation of Holistic Needs Assessment data in the sarcoma pathway (Oct 2025-Apr 2026), analysing types/timing of patient-reported concerns and free-text responses against documented clinical actions and referrals.

Determinants and rates of AKI and new-onset CKD in roughly 300 CAR-T therapy patients, using creatinine/eGFR time series, weight, and urine output to characterise renal dysfunction and its link to long-term outcomes.

Retrospective review of elective colorectal cancer surgery patients evaluating compliance with ERAS/ESPEN perioperative nutrition guidelines, including weight, BMI, diet initiation timing, supplements, and length of stay.

Sarcoma patients (including GIST) over 25 with confirmed recurrence more than 2 years post curative-intent treatment, capturing time to recurrence, detection method, local vs metastatic spread, and salvage success.

Lymphoma patients treated with glofitamab/blinatumumab, tracking CRS/ICANS grading, tocilizumab/steroid/furosemide use, and creatinine/eGFR trends to evaluate kidney-related complications of bispecific antibody therapy.

Adult solid-tumour oncology inpatients (2024-2026) who developed candidaemia, characterising risk factors, Candida species/antifungal susceptibility, and outcomes (mortality, ICU admission, length of stay).

Prostate cancer patients on androgen deprivation therapy plus androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, evaluating comorbidity/toxicity management (cardiac, bone, diabetic) and efficacy (testosterone suppression, imaging, compliance).

Referral pathway and outcomes for AML patients with TP53 mutation diagnosed via SIHMDS, tracking MDT discussion, treatment received, blood counts around treatment cycles, and relapse from Leukaemia MDT outcome notes.

Administration records (dates, location, SACT plan) for inpatients given Thymoglobuline/ATG since April 2020, to evaluate the incidence of infusion-related reactions and consider moving treatment to outpatient setting.

141 AML patients who received gemtuzumab ozogamicin (Mylotarg), tracking dosing frequency, lab parameters, and veno-occlusive liver disease complications to assess prescribing variation and predictors of side effects.
Counts of immune checkpoint inhibitor treatments (nivolumab, pembrolizumab, and others) across oncology and haematology since 2020, to support a business case for a neurotoxicity service.

TYA cancer patients (13-25) with a biopsy/histology sample, identifying whole genome sequencing completion by cancer type and disease stage (diagnosis/relapse), where WGS is embedded within bone marrow biopsy lab order text.

Patients with lacrimal outflow or nasolacrimal cancer, comparing morbidity and mortality between those who had orbital exenteration versus those who did not, combining EPIC data with historical paper-notes records.

Multiple myeloma patients on lenalidomide maintenance post autologous stem cell transplant (2021-2026), tracking dose reductions, supportive measures (GCSF, transfusions), and treatment tolerability against guideline compliance.

Prevalence of clonal haematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) in Waldenstrom macroglobulinaemia patients with NGS testing, assessing associations with inflammatory markers, cytopenias, neuropathy, and clinical phenotype.

Cohort of prostate cancer patients treated at UCLH (2015-2022) as the basis for assessing cardiovascular risk-screening uptake against ESC Cardio-Oncology guidelines and validating traditional versus novel CVD risk scores.

MRNs and proton beam therapy start/end dates for sarcoma, breast, neurology, and lymphoma patients (Feb-July 2026) to audit compliance and accuracy of a new nutritional screening tool for non-head-and-neck PBT patients.
